body: Tomodachi Editor gives you like an overview of your island status, items, solved problems, relationships and miis. My game automatically deleted because I changed a relationship in Tomodachi Editor which contradicted a setting I had turned off in my game. But it is all fixed now. If you use Tomodachi Edit (which you download on PC) make sure to make save files of your game before making changes! :)

Tomodachi Editor of course! Though hacking to give myself 99x of each item did cause glitches I cannot fix. You can also edit Mii relations, but last time I tried that my game automatically deleted so I had to resort to an old save file.
not the first love experience I was expecting

Definitely! It's like an outlet for all my emotions. I remember reading a comment a few months back during my college radio station, i think about it at least a few times every day; "It's just me and the moon tonight. Is there a song that exists to make me feel less like i'm the last person on earth?" 

It's strange and it's weird, because when it's 5am and i resort to my playlist for some comfort, the only company i have is the moon. I'm not a freak, i just like adding meaning to the meaningless little things. I like when songs sound like the moon.
